# Club Creek

> A private five-bedroom retreat inside the Auburn University Club in Auburn, Alabama — booked direct, no service fees.

Club Creek (also known as Hydrangea House) is a creekside home ten minutes from Toomer's Corner and Jordan-Hare Stadium, available for game weekends, family stays, Camp War Eagle, Parents Weekend, Auburn University graduation weekends, golf weekends, and quiet weeks away.

This site is a static Vite app on Cloudflare Pages. Public HTML documents are listed below.

Primary public brand: Club Creek
House nickname / subtitle only: Hydrangea House

Production hostname (until a custom clubcreekrental domain is attached): https://hydrangea-house-d7s.pages.dev
Pages project name: hydrangea-house
Intended custom domain: clubcreekrental.com (or similar) — set VITE_SITE_URL after that host is live on this same project.
Do not confuse with https://hydrangea-house.pages.dev (unrelated Kentucky interior design studio).
